class _PrivateClient:
    def __init__(self, source: ClientInput, model_template: ALCE):
        self.client_id = source.client_id
        self._train = _Tensors.from_batch(source.train)
        self._monitor = _Tensors.from_batch(source.monitor)
        self._validation = _Tensors.from_batch(source.validation)
        self._mean, self._std = source.target_mean, source.target_std
        self.sensitivity = source.sensitivity
        self.count = len(source.train.keys)

source_anchors.source_excerpt:
def _config(method,seed,lr,mu=.01,coeff=(.3,.3,.4),group='FULL',overrides=None):
    graph=method.removeprefix('graph_') if method.startswith('graph_') else None
    actual='climate_graph' if graph else method
    if actual!='caaa':coeff=(.3,.3,.4)  # unused CAAA fields remain canonical for exact candidate/final reuse
    values=dict(method=actual,seed=seed,rounds=60,local_epochs=3,batch_size=32,cpu_threads=2,lr=lr,prox_mu=mu,
                alpha=coeff[0],beta=coeff[1],gamma=coeff[2],graph_name=graph,
                primary_identity='global' if actual in ('central','fedavg','fedprox','caaa') else 'personal',use_embedding=group!='CORE')
    values.update(overrides or {})
    return asdict(_mods()['neural_benchmark'].StrictConfig(**values))

source_anchors.purpose: Nonzero anchor/ablations and CORE climate-free control are separately configured.

interpretation: The selected primary CAAA uses sample-size aggregation, which is uniform across the five balanced main clients. Performance and climate-relevance aggregation terms are inactive. Adaptive proximal local training and group-dependent climate embedding remain separately configured.
caveats: This derives prescribed weights from frozen source/data contracts; no recorded round curves or model metrics were inspected. Runtime execution verification belongs to completed-run QA.
Equal aggregation weights do not imply equal client model updates or identical forecasts to FedAvg/FedProx; local objectives, adaptive proximity and checkpoint identities can differ.
No claim of performance- or climate-adaptive aggregation benefit can be based on this selected primary configuration.
Enabled performance/climate flags still compute and transmit metadata despite zero beta/gamma; do not claim those communication costs vanish.
Embedding is enabled for CLIMATE/FULL and its TRAIN_SELECTED alias, but disabled for CORE. Shared neural comparators use the same backbone; this is not an isolated embedding-effect result.
The separately configured [.3,.3,.4] anchor and its ablations are not covered by the uniform-weight conclusion.
Uniformity relies on equal positive train counts/full participation; it is not a universal property of CAAA or unequal-client deployments.
